page.title: Tag Management
page.clickHint: Click on a tag name to view and edit its details.
page.routingHint: You can use tags to restrict the usage of certain LLMs based on tags passed in the request. Read more about tag routing <1>here</1>.

table.emptyDescription: Create a tag to start routing and restricting model usage.
table.dynamicViewTooltip: You cannot view the information of a dynamically generated spend tag
table.dynamicEditTooltip: Dynamically generated spend tags cannot be edited
table.dynamicDeleteTooltip: Dynamically generated spend tags cannot be deleted

form.allowedModelsHint: Select which models are allowed to process this type of data
form.maxBudgetHint: Maximum amount in USD this tag can spend
form.resetBudgetHint: How often the budget should reset
form.tpmRpmUnsupported: TPM/RPM limits for tags are not currently supported. If you need this feature, please <1>create a GitHub issue</1>.

createModal.title: Create New Tag
createModal.allowedModelsHint: Select which models are allowed to process requests from this tag
createModal.maxBudgetHint: Maximum amount in USD this tag can spend. When reached, requests with this tag will be blocked
createModal.resetBudgetHint: How often the budget should reset. For example, setting 'daily' will reset the budget every 24 hours
createModal.tpmRpmUnsupported: TPM/RPM limits for tags are not currently supported. If you need this feature, please <1>create a GitHub issue</1>.

deleteModal.title: Delete Tag
